newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept ethylene output up 4.6 pct yr/yr - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept ethylene output up 4.6 pct yr/yr - MITI.

text.p: Japan's ethylene production in September was 570,000 tonnes, up 4.6 percent compared to the same period a year earlier but down seven percent from August, the trade ministry said on Tuesday.

During the three months from July to September, output of ethylene reached 1.83 million tonnes, 8.4 percent higher than the same period a year earlier and up 5.7 percent from the previous quarter, according to ministry data.
In September, two ethylene factories owned by separate petrochemical product firms were closed for scheduled maintenance checks, the ministry said.
